titre: Impayés sur les prêts de bureaux titrisés
sous_titre: En % de l'encours, mois par mois en 2026

series.nom: Taux d'impayés des prêts de bureaux titrisés

Janv. 2026.texte: The largest rate increase was in office, which rose 103 basis points to an all-time high of 12.34 percent.

Févr. 2026.texte: Office posted the largest decline, falling 114 basis points to 11.20 percent.

Mars 2026.texte: Office rose 51 basis points to 11.71 percent, maintaining the elevated range established over the past year.

Avr. 2026.texte: The office rate is largely in line with March, declining 2 basis points to 11.69 percent.

Mai 2026.texte: Office decreased 16 basis points to 11.53 percent as cures and payoffs exceeded new inflows.

Juin 2026.texte: Office edged up 4 basis points to 11.57 percent as large new central business district delinquencies.

Juil. 2026.texte: Office increased by 34 basis points to 11.91%.
